K. OTRAS FORMAS DE TRABAJO (TRABAJO SIN REMUNERACIÓN EN PRODUCCIÓN DE SERVICIOS)

assessments.reasoning: The GEIH questionnaire records time spent on paid work in Section I (Question 52 asking for usual weekly hours and Question 54 for actual hours worked last week). It also records time allocated to unpaid domestic and care work in Section K (Questions 1 through 6 record days per week and daily hours for activities such as cooking, washing clothes, house cleaning, childcare, care for sick/elderly persons, and school homework support). However, the questionnaire contains no questions or modules that record time spent on leisure or self-care activities (such as sleeping, eating, or personal hygiene).
